# Window coeffs: Q2.14
# Accumulators: Q8.56

# Format per test case:
# <test_name>
# <num_samples> <num_bins> <fs>
# FREQ_BINS <freq0_Hz> <freq1_Hz> ... (reference)
# FREQ_STEPS <step0_hex> <step1_hex> ... (for CORDIC phase accumulators)
# SAMPLES (per line: I Q window_coeff)
# EXPECTED A_real[0..K-1] A_imag[0..K-1] (hex)
# GOLDEN A_real[0..K-1] A_imag[0..K-1] |A|[0..K-1] (float reference)
#
